bot_challenge.title: Open Data BCN is blocking Bicing access
bot_challenge.description:
The Open Data BCN portal blocked Home Assistant with an anti-bot challenge. Your token may still be valid.

**Important:** open [{challenge_url}]({challenge_url}) from a device that uses the **same public IP address** as Home Assistant (typically a phone/PC on the same home network). Completing the captcha only improves the reputation of that IP.

If Home Assistant uses a different public IP (cloud, VPN, mobile data, etc.), solving the captcha will not help. In that case, wait and retry later, or restart the router so Home Assistant gets a new public IP.

After completing the challenge (or changing IP), open this repair and confirm to retry.

confirm.title: Unblock Open Data BCN access
confirm.description:
1. Open [{challenge_url}]({challenge_url}) from a device with the **same public IP** as Home Assistant.
2. Complete the captcha.
3. Press submit below to retry.

If it keeps failing, restart the router to change the public IP and try again.

error.challenge_still_blocked: The portal is still blocking requests. Complete the challenge from the same public IP as Home Assistant, or restart the router and try again.
error.temporary_error: A temporary API error occurred. Please try again in a moment.
error.auth_failed: The API rejected the token. Update the token in the integration settings.
